description: Shared instruction/reference inventory with Skill discovery metadata, normative owner validation, and temporary Claude compatibility-fallback enforcement.

discovery.positive: execution-lifecycle-gate or an explicit Advisor review contract requires a read-scope declaration that passes the target files.
discovery.negative: Ordinary review, a quick check, proofreading, or similar work that does not need an independent Advisor's read scope to be fixed.
discovery.conditional: Apply the execution lifecycle's independence and read-only conditions, and instruction-root resolution through reference-map.
discovery.failure: If the Skill contract, instruction root, target identity, or required read scope cannot be resolved, stop fail-safe.

discovery.positive: A decision is needed on dispatch, reuse, handoff, Evidence child, role, session, or epoch identity.
discovery.negative: Short, self-contained work that involves no delegation or session identity.
discovery.conditional: Resolve, under the necessary conditions, only the model guide that corresponds to the selected delegate model.
discovery.failure: If the model guide or a dependency contract cannot be resolved, stop fail-safe.

discovery.positive: Create, update, or review an implementation plan or runbook.
discovery.negative: Editing a mere work note or a short explanatory text, where the plan's ownership scope is not used.
discovery.conditional: Maintain the common policy kernel and the execution lifecycle's approval, target, and review contract.
discovery.failure: If the plan's target, constraints, estimate basis, or applicable contract cannot be fixed, stop fail-safe.

nodes.host_fallback_reason: It accepts only an explicit review-consolidation invocation, so it is outside the natural-language fallback.

discovery.positive: The user or the target task explicitly invokes review-consolidation to consolidate review state.
discovery.negative: Ordinary Issue / Pull Request operations, or maintenance without an explicit invocation.
discovery.conditional: The corresponding Skills for GitHub service, authorization, approval request, and external posting are resolved only when their responsibilities arise.
discovery.failure: If a conditional dependency or the target history cannot be resolved, stop fail-safe and report.

discovery.positive: Handles Git state, index/ref, diff range, permission errors, locks, and scope control of formatter/lint output.
discovery.negative: Ordinary writing or coding work that does not deal with Git state or range.
discovery.conditional: Maintain the responsibility boundary between the common policy kernel and the commit-message Skill, and resolve only the dependencies that are needed.
discovery.failure: If Git identity, range, permissions, or a dependency contract cannot be fixed, stop fail-safe.

discovery.positive: Output copyable code, or text to be handed to another agent, into the chat.
discovery.negative: Ordinary explanation or conversation that requires no special output format.
discovery.conditional: There is no additional dependency contract.
discovery.failure: If the format contract cannot be resolved, stop fail-safe and report.

discovery.positive: Discovery of an explicit permission or judgment is needed before execution proceeds.
discovery.negative: There is no approval request, and only ordinary build, test, or review is run.
discovery.conditional: The external-operation-authorization Skill is applied only when an authorization-boundary responsibility arises. Redesign material is contained in this Skill's non-runtime Design section and is not applied in ordinary runtime.
discovery.failure: If a dependency contract cannot be resolved, stop fail-safe and report.

discovery.positive: Create or edit a new commit message or the message of an amend target.
discovery.negative: No commit message is created; existing history is only read.
discovery.conditional: There is no additional dependency contract; the history of the current Git repository is checked directly.
discovery.failure: If the basis for the format or history cannot be fixed, stop fail-safe and report.

discovery.positive: Run a build or test of a .NET project.
discovery.negative: Verification other than .NET, or explanation only with no command run.
discovery.conditional: There is no additional dependency contract.
discovery.failure: If the conditions for the build or test cannot be fixed, stop fail-safe and report.

discovery.positive: Create or send text to an external location that other users can see.
discovery.negative: Only local verification or internal notes, with no body text sent externally.
discovery.conditional: The external operation authorization contract is resolved only when the posting's authorization boundary is needed.
discovery.failure: If the authorization boundary or the posting conditions cannot be resolved, stop fail-safe.

discovery.positive: Read or write a resource on the GitHub service/API.
discovery.negative: Operate only on a local checkout of a Git repository or on Git transport.
discovery.conditional: Apply the common policy kernel, and when redesign material is needed, refer to the non-runtime Design section in this Skill. Common authorization is not defined redundantly.
discovery.failure: If the GitHub service contract cannot be resolved, stop fail-safe.

discovery.positive: Interpret the structure of JSON, or extract values and hierarchy.
discovery.negative: Merely displaying the full text, or an ordinary Markdown search, without interpreting structure.
discovery.conditional: There is no additional dependency contract; only the result of a structured parser is used.
discovery.failure: If it cannot be interpreted by a structured parser, stop fail-safe and report.

discovery.positive: Decide the authorization or execution lifecycle of a logical operation that has external effects, such as push, an external service/API write, posting, publishing, or deploying.
discovery.negative: There is no operation with external effects, and only local work and verification are done.
discovery.conditional: The GitHub service, approval discovery, external posting, and review evidence Skills are each applied only when their own responsibilities arise, and the authorization boundary is not defined redundantly.
discovery.failure: If the target, operation, approval, boundary, or execution result cannot be confirmed, stop fail-safe and perform no external operation.
